maya (support): Hey team — Customer (prod) reports SSE stream cutting out after ~12–20m of idle time. Request-id `r-8bf4a2`. They see a partial last chunk and then client reconnect spam which yields 401s and duplicate billing.
kevin (sre): Can you paste a short repro / curl you used? Also which LB in front of them (ALB/NLB/Cloudflare)?
maya (support): They are behind an ALB in front of nginx (customer infra) then Cloudflare. Repro we ran:
```bash
curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \\  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\  "https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/stream?session=r-8bf4a2"
```
It shows: after ~14m no bytes, then TCP FIN from ALB -> origin. pcap attached (snip): `ALB -> FIN, origin -> FIN/ACK, server sends last chunk then connection closed`.
linda (eng): That pattern sounds like ALB idle timeout + half-close. ALB sometimes sends TCP FIN when it thinks connection idle; if origin does a half-close and then sends trailing chunk, client can miss it. Do we have application logs for the `r-8bf4a2` stream around 2025-11-12T14:05Z?
maya (support): Uploaded logs: `stream.open`, `prefix_cached = true`, last write at 14:04:57Z, we flush chunk `data: {"delta":"..."}

` then saw `net: write failed: broken pipe` in runtime logs.
nick (infra): Also saw ALB access log: `ELB-HealthChecker/2.0 - "GET /health HTTP/1.1" 200 -` every 30s for that target group. But idle timeout for ALB was default 60s on their side? (customer uses 60s). ALB TCP idle teardown after 60s will race with long-lived SSE if no bytes.
kevin (sre): Common fixes: (1) add periodic SSE heartbeat comment every 15–25s from server (e.g., `: keepalive\n\n`), (2) increase ALB idle timeout to >300s, (3) configure Cloudflare origin keepalive + disable HTTP/2 proxying to avoid h2 to h1 conversion quirks. Which is feasible for them?
maya (support): They can't change Cloudflare settings easily. Ops asked if we can push heartbeats from Redwood runtime. Is that safe? Any perf/cost implications?
linda (eng): We can emit zero-length comment heartbeats from the server runtime per-session when `streaming=true` and `client_heartbeat` unset. Low token cost (no model run). It will keep ALB and Cloudflare from idling. We do need to ensure we don't break KV cache semantics (no-op). I'd prefer a config toggle per-customer.
sre-bot: Notice: rollout flag `stream-heartbeat` exists in staging only.
kevin (sre): Short-term workaround for the customer: set ALB idle timeout to 350s and enable `Connection: keep-alive` upstream between nginx and origin. Longer-term: enable heartbeat toggle in runtime for dedicated/private tenants.
maya (support): Also the customer reported duplicate billing when client reconnects: they reconnect, new request consumes tokens and old session was still charged because model generation completed server-side. Any suggestions to mitigate?
linda (eng): We should ensure reconnects with same session id are detected and a reconnect attempt checks session state before executing expensive model work. E.g., if session already finished, return final events only. For now, we can suggest the client detect 401/403 on reconnect and not auto-retry.
nick (infra): One more subtlety: nginx config on customer side had `proxy_busy_buffers_size` low and `proxy_buffering on;` — that can coalesce chunks and delay heartbeats. Recommend `proxy_buffering off` for SSE endpoints and `sendfile off`.\evidence (maya (support)): Minimal repro steps for them to validate:
1) set ALB idle timeout = 350s (or > expected max idle)
2) set nginx `proxy_buffering off` on SSE location
3) run: `curl -v -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://.../stream?session=r-8bf4a2"` and leave idle for 20m. Observe if `: keepalive` arrives or connection remains open.
Sample tcpdump filter we asked them to run: `tcpdump -i eth0 host <client-ip> and port 443 -w /tmp/stream.pcap`
maya (support): Customer tried ALB timeout bump to 300s and `proxy_buffering off` and reported improved stability — no partial-last-chunk seen in 1h test. They will try longer run tomorrow.
kevin (sre): Good. Can we add a ticket to enable the heartbeat rollout flag for Hosted accounts with streaming enabled? Please include perf guardrails (no model invocations).
linda (eng): Will open ENG ticket and include a diagnostic flag to only send comments (no token spend). Also add a runtime metric for `last_sent_heartbeat` per session.
maya (support): Filed support follow-up with customer and recommended temporary ALB bump + nginx change. Marking P2.
kevin (sre): Thanks. If they still see 401 on reconnect, ask for the reconnect trace and `x-rw-request-id`. We should also check auth token TTL/rotation race on client side.
maya (support): Closing the thread for now — will reopen if they repro again after the overnight test. :thumbsup:
